You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Continual-ARC task bf51feec — recolor complete monochromatic lines

Solved using one demo; test submission was confirmed CORRECT.

## Rule
Find any complete horizontal row or vertical column whose cells are all the same non-background line color. Recolor every cell belonging to each such full line to `2`. Preserve all other cells and the grid dimensions. Where lines intersect, their union is still simply color `2`.

The line color is task-instance-specific (not fixed): in the demo the full lines were color `1`; in the test they were color `6`. Output color was `2` in both.

## Evidence: demo
Input was 8x19. Full color-1 lines included rows with indices 3 and 4 (0-based), and columns 9 and 18. Output changed all cells of these lines to `2`, preserving all other pixels.

## Evidence: test
Input was 6x27. Full color-6 lines were row index 2 and columns 11, 19, and 25 (0-based). The correct output was obtained by changing their union to `2`, leaving all else intact. The submission was confirmed correct.

## Pitfall / procedure
Check both axes for complete monochromatic lines; do not assume only separator rows or only columns. Recolor the whole line, including cells at intersections, and do not alter nearby partial runs or scattered instances of the same color.

## Additional accepted recurrence (2026-10-21; 28x12)
- Input field was mostly 3 with candidate line color 4. The complete 4-rows were r=2 and r=9 (0-based). The complete 4-columns were c=0 and c=8. Recolor exactly their union to 2; preserve every other 3 or 4. This output was accepted after one incorrect submission.
- First submission recolored rows 2,9 and column 8 but forgot the full first column c=0, so it was incorrect. This is an important verification pitfall: explicitly test every column including boundary columns and every row, rather than judging by visual prominence.
- Corrected second submission changed c=0 in every row, c=8 in every row, and all cells of rows 2 and 9 to 2. Intersections remain 2. No other complete monochromatic lines existed.
